name: 39-convert-claude-messages-group-predicate
description: The `startsWithGroupName` predicate of convertClaudeMessages, at the system-extraction call site (:212-216). Three `example_assistant` system turns go in and they must come out differently: 'Seraphina: good evening' already begins with a group member's name (`name + ': '`, colon **and** space, prompt-converters.js:55), so the predicate returns true and `charName` is *not* prepended; 'Narrator: hi' matches no group member, so it gets `Iris: `; and a turn with no name at all never enters the branch. This is the case a JSON `names` object cannot express at all -- the sentinel supplies a real function on both sides. The predicate's own behaviour is pinned separately by 01-prompt-names and 02-prompt-names-empty.
